build_mocov3_model: build a MoCoV3 self-supervised model with backbone, neck, and head config dicts
build_mocov3_vit_backbone: build a MoCoV3ViT Vision Transformer backbone with frozen stages and stop_grad_conv1 options
train_mocov3_loss: train a MoCoV3 model by calling loss with two augmented image view tensors
init_mocov3_weights: initialize MoCoV3ViT weights with 2D sin-cos position embedding and xavier_uniform for qkv layers
freeze_mocov3_stages: freeze MoCoV3ViT backbone stages by setting frozen_stages and calling _freeze_stages method
